requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin's _expand_targets method incorrectly returns False when API calls to get all users or group users fail, preventing notification delivery even when direct targets exist.
requirement.contract: When API calls to get all users or group users fail (return None), the _expand_targets method should continue processing and return the valid direct targets instead of returning False, allowing notification delivery to proceed.

requirement.description: The Apprise details() method fails to properly extract and return plugin details for some plugins, causing test failures in test_apprise_details_plugin_verification.
requirement.contract: The Apprise details() method should properly extract and return all required plugin details including service_name, service_url, setup_url, protocols, secure_protocols, and details for all registered plugins without throwing "None found but not defined in the template configuration" errors.
